findings.highlight: he doesn’t even try to figure out who is talking
findings.evidenceJa: それが誰であるかも判らず
findings.governingReading: Berserker cannot tell who Illya is.
findings.explanation: The English changes failed recognition into a refusal even to try identifying the speaker, adding volition.

findings.highlight: he swings his sword
findings.evidenceJa: 大剣を振り下ろそうと
findings.governingReading: Berserker is about to bring the great sword down when the page interrupts.
findings.explanation: The English completes an attack that remains at the point of attempted execution.

findings.highlight: The blood, drugs, and propellant
findings.evidenceJa: 血液麻薬推進剤
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s blood is figured as a narcotic propellant racing through his entire body like a jet stream.
findings.explanation: The English splits one fevered compound image into three separate substances.

findings.highlight: the sword he carries
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツが持つ大剣
findings.governingReading: The only possible answer is the giant’s great sword or axe-sword.
findings.explanation: The English removes the weapon’s size and established axe-sword identity.

findings.highlight: Projection succeeds as a matter of course.
findings.evidenceJa: “投影”は当然のように成功し、巨人の斧剣を受け止めた
findings.governingReading: Projection succeeds as naturally as expected and the replica catches Berserker’s axe-sword.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the successful block and the weapon being reproduced and opposed.

findings.highlight: “                 Ah.”
findings.governingReading: The active Japanese presents one spatially delayed “ah.”
findings.explanation: The English prints the same utterance twice.

findings.highlight: my body slides across the ground like trash
findings.evidenceJa: ゴミのように地面を転げ滑っていく
findings.governingReading: Shirou rolls and skids across the ground like refuse.
findings.explanation: The English omits the rolling component of his uncontrolled motion.

findings.highlight: My consciousness is fading.
findings.evidenceJa: 意識が無くなる
findings.governingReading: His consciousness disappears or is lost.
findings.explanation: The English weakens loss into an ongoing fade.

findings.highlight: I can’t think even if I gather up everything.
findings.evidenceJa: 散らばった自分を必死にかき集めても考えられない
findings.governingReading: Even desperately gathering the scattered pieces of himself cannot restore thought.
findings.explanation: The English changes his fragmented self into generic “everything” and omits desperation.

findings.highlight: my intelligence is half lost, and I feel a chill as though it’ll never return
findings.evidenceJa: 知能指数は半分になって二度ともう戻らないような悪寒
findings.governingReading: He suffers the dreadful premonition that merely projecting while still bound may halve his intelligence permanently.
findings.explanation: The English states that half his intelligence is already lost, promoting a feared possibility into measured fact.

findings.highlight: My mind turns into a grain of sand within a desert
findings.evidenceJa: 我は砂漠に落ちた粒となって
findings.governingReading: His whole “I” becomes one grain fallen into a desert.
findings.explanation: The English narrows dissolution of the self into a transformation of the mind.

findings.highlight: His red, glaring eyes are looking around
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い両眼をギラつかせている
findings.governingReading: Berserker’s red eyes glitter as though searching for Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English turns their glitter into an angry glare and makes the inferred scanning explicit.

findings.highlight: The only external wounds are scratches from tree branches.
findings.evidenceJa: 出血なんて滲む程度
findings.governingReading: Visible bleeding amounts only to slight oozing from the branch scratches.
findings.explanation: The English omits even the limited bleeding from its external-wound inventory.

findings.highlight: It’s just pain. My tongue tries to gasp for air.
findings.evidenceJa: ただ苦しい。ぜいぜいと喘ぐ舌
findings.governingReading: Beyond minor external injury, he is in respiratory agony, his tongue wheezing and gasping.
findings.explanation: The English calls this “just pain” and makes the tongue merely try to gasp.

findings.highlight: I want air.
findings.evidenceJa: 満足な呼吸が欲しい
findings.governingReading: His oxygen-empty body craves one adequate, satisfying breath.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the concrete need for a full breath into wanting air.

findings.highlight: What’s important is inside my bodyI
findings.evidenceJa: 肝心なのは中身
findings.governingReading: What matters is his internal condition.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “body” and “I” into malformed prose.

findings.highlight: I don’t really want to know what condition it’s in
findings.evidenceJa: 冷静に診断したくもない
findings.governingReading: Shirou refuses to diagnose his internal state calmly.
findings.explanation: The English omits the diagnostic and deliberate quality of the assessment he avoids.

findings.highlight: I have to get out of his range
findings.evidenceJa: たとえ一分でもヤツの間合いから離れて
findings.governingReading: Shirou needs to leave Berserker’s range even for one minute to regulate his breathing.
findings.explanation: The English omits the minimal one-minute recovery window.

findings.highlight: pulls away, as if denying my assistance
findings.evidenceJa: 俺の手を拒むように引き下がった
findings.governingReading: Illya draws back as if rejecting Shirou’s offered hand.
findings.explanation: The English abstracts the immediate physical rejection into refusing assistance generally.

findings.highlight: Berserker is right behind her
findings.evidenceJa: こちらに狙いを定めようとするバーサーカー
findings.governingReading: Berserker stands behind Illya trying to set his aim on them.
findings.explanation: The English omits the active targeting and reduces him to a location.

findings.highlight: I’m myself, my head’s not working due to oxygen deprivation
findings.evidenceJa: 俺は俺で酸欠で頭が正常じゃなく
findings.governingReading: As for Shirou, oxygen deprivation has left his mind abnormal.
findings.explanation: The English literalizes the topic phrase as the nonsensical claim “I’m myself.”

findings.highlight: She hits my head.
findings.evidenceJa: ぽかぽかと頭を叩いてくる
findings.governingReading: Illya repeatedly thumps Shirou lightly on the head.
findings.explanation: The English removes the repeated, ineffectual, almost comic quality of the blows.

findings.highlight: I pull her close.
findings.evidenceJa: ぎゅっと、イリヤの体を抱きしめた
findings.governingReading: Shirou tightly embraces Illya’s body.
findings.explanation: The English turns a firm embrace into generic repositioning.

findings.highlight: Onii-chan
findings.evidenceJa: お兄ちゃん
findings.governingReading: Shirou refers back to Illya having called him “big brother.”
findings.explanation: mirror moon leaves the kinship address untranslated despite translating the surrounding brother/sister argument.

findings.highlight: It’s a bit strange.
findings.evidenceJa: 少し、異常だった
findings.governingReading: The speed is somewhat abnormal.
findings.explanation: The English weakens physiological abnormality into ordinary strangeness.

findings.highlight: My lungs are burning from lack of air
findings.evidenceJa: 酸素が足りなくて苦しいのに
findings.governingReading: He suffers from insufficient oxygen despite not breathing irregularly.
findings.explanation: The English invents burning lungs and relocates a systemic oxygen deficit into them.

findings.highlight: My heart’s gone on strike.
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓はさっきから完全にストライキに入っている
findings.governingReading: His heart has been completely on strike since earlier.
findings.explanation: The English omits both totality and duration.

findings.highlight: Illya’s fingers are unnaturally hot.
findings.evidenceJa: 握り返してくるイリヤの指
findings.governingReading: Illya’s fingers grip Shirou back and feel frighteningly hot.
findings.explanation: The English omits her reciprocal squeeze.

findings.highlight: unnaturally hot
findings.evidenceJa: 恐ろしいまでに熱かった
findings.governingReading: Her fingers are hot to a frightening degree.
findings.explanation: The English changes Shirou’s emotional measure of intensity into an inference that the heat is physiologically unnatural.

findings.highlight: The mad, senseless giant
findings.evidenceJa: 五感全てを封じられ、理性まで奪われたあの巨人
findings.governingReading: The giant has had all five senses sealed and even his reason taken away.
findings.explanation: The English compresses two specific losses and their external/passive causality into generic madness and senselessness.

findings.highlight: Thoughts are useless.
findings.evidenceJa: 雑念は邪魔だ
findings.governingReading: Extraneous or distracting thoughts are an obstacle.
findings.explanation: The English condemns all thought rather than the distracting thoughts he suppresses.

findings.highlight: I somehow widened the gap between us
findings.evidenceJa: 一時、何かの間違いで引き離した
findings.governingReading: For a moment they gained distance as though by some mistake or anomaly.
findings.explanation: The English assigns Shirou the result and omits its temporary, almost accidental character.

findings.highlight: I can only run for about ten more meters
findings.evidenceJa: 動けるのはあと十メートル足らず
findings.governingReading: He calmly judges that he can move less than ten meters farther.
findings.explanation: The English specifies running and rounds a strict under-ten limit to about ten.

findings.highlight: Wellhiding wouldn’t accomplish much
findings.evidenceJa: 尤も何も見えてない巨人
findings.governingReading: In any case, hiding is meaningless against the sightless giant.
findings.explanation: The English joins “Well” and “hiding” into malformed text.

findings.highlight: There’s a crater.
findings.evidenceJa: 地割れのような窪み
findings.governingReading: The clearing contains a depression like a fissure in the earth.
findings.explanation: The English makes the simile into a definite impact crater.

findings.highlight: The trench
findings.evidenceJa: 塹壕じみた穴
findings.governingReading: The hole resembles a trench.
findings.explanation: The English removes the simile and makes it literally a trench.

findings.highlight: I relax and rest my body
findings.evidenceJa: 極限にあった精神を緩める安息
findings.governingReading: The brief rest loosens a mind that had been held at its absolute limit.
findings.explanation: The English shifts the respite to his body and omits the extremity of his mental state.

findings.highlight: he’ll track us down and kill us
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に追い、捕らえ、惨殺する
findings.governingReading: Berserker will unfailingly pursue, capture, and brutally slaughter them.
findings.explanation: The English omits capture and the brutality of the killing.

findings.highlight: Illya’s frantically hugging herself so she won’t be a burden on me
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤは声を殺して、こちらに負担をかけないよう、懸命に自分の体を抱いている
findings.governingReading: Illya stifles her voice and desperately holds her own body so as not to burden Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English omits deliberate silence and changes strenuous self-control into frantic hugging.

findings.highlight: I look down at my left arm.
findings.evidenceJa: 赤布に視線を落とす
findings.governingReading: Shirou lowers his gaze to the red cloth binding the arm.
findings.explanation: The English names the arm and removes the visible restraint that is the immediate object of choice.

findings.highlight: The sole weapon to overcome this situation
findings.evidenceJa: 唯一の打開策
findings.governingReading: The bound arm presents the sole means of breaking the deadlock.
findings.explanation: The English classifies the solution as a weapon, though the source describes its tactical function.

findings.highlight: if I released my arm
findings.evidenceJa: この布を解いた時
findings.governingReading: Shirou imagines the pain when he unties the cloth.
findings.explanation: The English changes a precise physical action on the restraint into releasing the arm itself.

findings.highlight: The firing hammer is always in my head.
findings.evidenceJa: 撃鉄は常に頭に
findings.governingReading: The metaphorical gun’s hammer remains constantly trained on his head.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the hammer inside his head.

findings.highlight: the shadow
findings.evidenceJa: あの得体の知れない影
findings.governingReading: Shirou resolves to defeat that incomprehensible, uncanny shadow and tear it away from Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English omits the shadow’s unknown and uncanny nature.

findings.highlight: I’m going.
findings.evidenceJa: 外に出る
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he will go out of the depression to confront Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the tactical movement into generic departure.

findings.highlight: I’m going to defeat him, Illya.
findings.evidenceJa: あいつを倒していいな、イリヤ
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks Illya to accept or confirm that he may defeat Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English turns a request for assent into a unilateral declaration, weakening the emotional cost to Illya.

findings.highlight: You’ll die. No, you’ll be killed first!
findings.evidenceJa: 死ぬのよ、いいえ、死ぬ前に殺されるわ
findings.governingReading: Illya corrects bodily death: Archer’s arm will destroy who Shirou is before his body dies.
findings.explanation: The English reads the correction as being killed before dying, an incoherent sequence that loses her warning about loss of self.

findings.highlight: EhShirou…?
findings.evidenceJa: えシロウ……？
findings.governingReading: Illya’s startled interjection precedes Shirou’s name.
findings.explanation: The English fuses the interjection and name into “EhShirou.”

findings.highlight: I pat her head
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの頭に右手を置いて
findings.governingReading: Shirou places his right hand lightly on Illya’s head.
findings.explanation: The English omits which hand he uses, significant while his left arm is bound and dangerous.

findings.highlight: I pat her head and walk away
findings.evidenceJa: 亀裂の中で足を進めた
findings.governingReading: Shirou advances within the fissure-like hollow.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the spatially bounded movement to walking away.

findings.highlight: so she doesn’t get involved in the fight
findings.evidenceJa: 万が一にもイリヤを巻き込まないように
findings.governingReading: He creates distance so there is not even the remotest chance Illya is caught in the battle.
findings.explanation: The English removes the emphatic risk threshold and changes involuntary collateral involvement into generic participation.

findings.highlight: the knot by my shoulder
findings.evidenceJa: 左肩、聖骸布の結び目
findings.governingReading: Shirou reaches the Holy Shroud’s knot at his left shoulder.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the left-side orientation and the named holy binding.

findings.highlight: The knot by my wrist is tight
findings.evidenceJa: 手首は際立って強く結ばれている
findings.governingReading: The wrist is bound with conspicuous or exceptional tightness.
findings.explanation: The English removes the exceptional degree and recasts the binding as a knot at the wrist.

findings.highlight: pain that’s ten times worse
findings.evidenceJa: 何十倍もの、あの痛み
findings.governingReading: The pain will be dozens of times what Shirou has experienced.
findings.explanation: The English fixes the open plural magnitude at exactly tenfold.

findings.highlight: If I’ll be sane or not.
findings.evidenceJa: 正気でいられるか、と
findings.governingReading: He fears whether he will be able to remain sane.
findings.explanation: The English renders the embedded fear as a malformed sentence fragment.

findings.highlight: I’m scared of myself.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺自身が怖くて怖くてたまらない
findings.governingReading: Shirou is unbearably terrified of himself, with fear repeated for emphasis.
findings.explanation: The English removes repetition and intolerable degree.

findings.highlight: lose my sanity and forget about Illya and Sakura
findings.evidenceJa: 自分も判らなくなってイリヤも桜も判らなくなる
findings.governingReading: Before fighting, Shirou may cease to recognize himself, Illya, and Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes loss of identity and recognition into generic insanity and forgetting about the girls.

findings.highlight: the promise to protect them
findings.evidenceJa: 守ると誓った言葉
findings.governingReading: He fears forgetting even the words of the vow he made to protect.
findings.explanation: The English supplies “them” as the explicit object, narrowing an intentionally compact callback.

findings.highlight: if I give in to the pain and lose my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 左腕の痛みに耐えかね、正気を失えば
findings.governingReading: If Shirou can no longer endure the left arm’s pain and loses sanity, he will become like Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English removes the arm as the pain’s source and turns exceeded endurance into volitional “giving in.”

findings.highlight: Yeahthat’s good enough.
findings.evidenceJa: ああそれで充分だ
findings.governingReading: Shirou answers, “Yeah. That’s enough.”
findings.explanation: The English fuses “Yeah” and “that.”

findings.highlight: There’s something I can’t give up, and that’s why I continue to live.
findings.evidenceJa: 譲れないモノは変わらず、その為に在り続ける
findings.governingReading: What Shirou cannot yield remains unchanged, and he continues to exist for its sake.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the value’s continuity into mere existence and normalizes existential 在り続ける into living.

findings.highlight: I put my hand on the red penalty.
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い罰に力を篭める
findings.governingReading: Shirou pours strength into the red punishment—the binding he is about to tear away.
findings.explanation: The English changes exerted force into merely placing a hand on it.

findings.highlight: rip the clot
findings.evidenceJa: 引き裂くように右腕を
findings.governingReading: He drives his right arm as though tearing the binding apart.
findings.explanation: The English truncates “cloth” to “clot,” producing a materially misleading malformed line at the page break.

findings.highlight: going faster than a hundred meters per second
findings.evidenceJa: 秒速百メートルを優に超える超風
findings.governingReading: The super-wind easily exceeds one hundred meters per second.
findings.explanation: The English omits the margin expressed by “easily.”

findings.highlight: Therefore, it’s not a wind.
findings.evidenceJa: 既に風などではない
findings.governingReading: What strikes Shirou is already beyond anything that can be called wind.
findings.explanation: The English adds “Therefore,” presenting a logical inference rather than an experiential escalation.

findings.highlight: I can’t even groan in protest.
findings.evidenceJa: 抵抗する苦悶さえあげられない
findings.governingReading: He cannot even voice the agony of resisting.
findings.explanation: The English turns embodied resistance and anguish into verbal protest.

findings.highlight: Why am I here?
findings.evidenceJa: 前へ。
findings.governingReading: The passage repeatedly interleaves commands to move forward—toward the far side and through the wind—with questions about purpose.
findings.explanation: The English deletes all four spatially staged “Forward” lines, leaving only the dissolving questions and removing the counterforce of resolve.

findings.highlight: My body lost already
findings.evidenceJa: 体は初めから敗れていても
findings.governingReading: Even though Shirou’s body was defeated from the outset, his heart had clenched against defeat.
findings.explanation: The English produces malformed phrasing and changes a defeated body into a body already lost.

findings.highlight: not letting my mind lose… but my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 心だけは負けるものかと食いしばっていた心
findings.governingReading: The heart that had gritted itself against surrender now disappears.
findings.explanation: The English changes the repeated heart to mind, weakening the will-centered image.

findings.highlight: I can use that to move forward
findings.evidenceJa: その感覚を足場にして前に出れる
findings.governingReading: If any body part moves, its sensation can serve as a foothold from which Shirou advances.
findings.explanation: The English omits the crucial foothold metaphor connecting sensation to movement.

findings.highlight: My vision fades away.
findings.evidenceJa: 薄れていく意識と視界
findings.governingReading: Both consciousness and vision are fading.
findings.explanation: The English omits the loss of consciousness.

findings.highlight: I grit my teeth.
findings.evidenceJa: ギリギリと歯を鳴らした
findings.governingReading: His teeth audibly grind against one another.
findings.explanation: The English omits the grating sound and movement.

findings.highlight: his face is slightly turned away
findings.evidenceJa: わずかに振り向いた貌
findings.governingReading: The red knight turns his stern face slightly back toward Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the direction, making him turn away.

findings.highlight: The crimes I’ve accumulated
findings.evidenceJa: 溜めに溜めた罰
findings.governingReading: The punishment accumulated upon punishment will judge Shirou himself.
findings.explanation: The English changes punishment awaiting him into crimes he committed, moralizing the image and changing its actor.

findings.highlight: My limbs cut through the wind like giant swords.
findings.evidenceJa: 手足は、大剣を振るうかの如く風を切り
findings.governingReading: His arms and legs cut through the wind as though wielding a great sword.
findings.explanation: The English turns his limbs themselves into giant swords and loses the action analogy.

findings.highlight: I pass the red figure
findings.evidenceJa: 赤い背中を突破した
findings.governingReading: Shirou breaks through and passes the red-cloaked back with all his strength.
findings.explanation: The English removes the breakthrough and changes the specifically seen back into a generic figure.

findings.highlight: There’s about thirty meters
findings.evidenceJa: 距離にして三十メートル
findings.governingReading: The distance to Berserker is thirty meters.
findings.explanation: The English adds approximation absent from the tactical measurement.

findings.highlight: growth experience
findings.evidenceJa: 憑依経験
findings.governingReading: The Projection inventory reproduces possession or accumulated wielding experience embedded in the object.
findings.explanation: The English mistranslates it as growth experience.

findings.highlight: Projection using creation concept
findings.evidenceJa: 物質投影
findings.governingReading: The listed reconstruction process produces material Projection.
findings.explanation: The English omits the material classification from the sentence.

findings.highlight: I’ll still be killed in one blow.
findings.evidenceJa: 斬られれば殺されるのは以前のまま
findings.governingReading: The correction states that if Shirou is cut, he will be killed just as before.
findings.explanation: The English adds the claim that any death will occur in one blow.

findings.highlight: the Noble Phantasm best suited for the situation
findings.evidenceJa: 使用目的に最も適した宝具
findings.governingReading: The arm searches for the Noble Phantasm best suited to the specific intended use.
findings.explanation: The English broadens functional purpose into the whole situation.

findings.highlight: put all my magical energy into my left arm
findings.evidenceJa: 全魔力を左腕に叩き込む
findings.governingReading: Shirou slams all his magical energy into the left arm.
findings.explanation: The English removes the violent force of delivery.

findings.highlight: I see through his giant sword.
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの大剣を寸分違わず透視する
findings.governingReading: Shirou scans Berserker’s great sword without a fraction of deviation.
findings.explanation: The English omits the exactness essential to reproduction.

findings.highlight: Butmy left arm
findings.evidenceJa: だがこの左腕ならば
findings.governingReading: But with this left arm, Shirou can reproduce the weapon-associated monstrous strength.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “But” and “my.”

findings.highlight: reproduce the strength of my enemy
findings.evidenceJa: 敵の怪力ごと確実に複製しよう
findings.governingReading: The arm will reproduce the weapon together with the enemy’s monstrous strength.
findings.explanation: The English weakens 怪力 to generic strength and obscures that it is copied along with the weapon.

findings.highlight: A part of my brain explodes.
findings.evidenceJa: パシ、と音をたてて脳の一部が破裂する
findings.governingReading: Part of Shirou’s brain ruptures with a sharp snapping sound.
findings.explanation: The English omits the audible snap.

findings.highlight: My bones break, not being able to withstand the overflowing magical energy.
findings.evidenceJa: 骨格は流出する魔力に耐え切れず瓦解
findings.governingReading: His skeletal frame collapses because it cannot withstand magical energy flowing out.
findings.explanation: The English changes structural collapse into broken bones and blurs the outward direction of the magical flow.

findings.highlight: It’s unsightly like apple skin.
findings.evidenceJa: リンゴの皮みたいにみっともない
findings.governingReading: His collapsing skeletal state is ignominious or pathetic like an apple peel.
findings.explanation: The English copies the comparison into unnatural, opaque English.

findings.highlight: His hostility now has a focus.
findings.evidenceJa: 収束する殺意
findings.governingReading: Berserker’s killing intent converges upon Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English weakens murderous intent to hostility.

findings.highlight: Recognizing my use of magic as a threat
findings.evidenceJa: こちらの魔術行使を敵と見なし
findings.governingReading: Berserker interprets Shirou’s magecraft use as marking him an enemy.
findings.explanation: The English changes categorical enemy identification into assessment as a threat.

findings.highlight: They’re like ominous stars.
findings.evidenceJa: 黒い、凶つ星のようだ
findings.governingReading: The black giant or its focused gaze is like a single baleful star.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the image and drops blackness.

findings.highlight: The giant is insane, but still the same.
findings.evidenceJa: 憤怒のまま、巨人は変わってはいなかった
findings.governingReading: Despite his present rage, the giant has not fundamentally changed: he remains inside the battle with Saber and fights to protect Illya.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes insanity for rage, obscuring the continuity beneath corruption.

findings.highlight: his body is rotting
findings.evidenceJa: 全身を腐敗させながら
findings.governingReading: His entire body has been left decayed after two deaths.
findings.explanation: The English weakens the whole-body extent and completed damage into ongoing generic rotting.

findings.highlight: Tracing won’t do the trick.
findings.evidenceJa: 投影魔術では届かない
findings.governingReading: Ordinary Projection magecraft cannot reach the level required to defeat Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English switches terminology to “Tracing” and colloquializes the limit as not doing the trick.

findings.highlight: Trigger, off.
findings.evidenceJa: 投影、装填
findings.governingReading: The written line says “Projection, loaded,” while its ruby supplies the spoken “Trigger Off.”
findings.explanation: The English preserves only the ruby reading and deletes the loading meaning carried by the displayed Japanese.

findings.highlight: all twenty-seven Magic Circuits in my head
findings.evidenceJa: 体内に眠る二十七の魔術回路
findings.governingReading: Twenty-seven magical circuits lie dormant throughout Shirou’s body and are all mobilized.
findings.explanation: The English relocates all twenty-seven circuits into his head, confusing them with the nine items held in his mind.

findings.highlight: Trigger, off.
findings.evidenceJa: 投影、装填
findings.governingReading: The ruby names the technique “Trigger Off.”
findings.explanation: The inserted comma makes it read as an addressed or interrupted phrase rather than a compound command.

findings.highlight: SetNine Lives Blade Works.
findings.evidenceJa: 全工程投影完了是、射殺す百頭
findings.governingReading: The displayed incantation states that every Projection process is complete and identifies the result with Shooting the Hundred Heads, while ruby supplies “Set” and “Nine Lives Blade Works.”
findings.explanation: The English retains only the ruby wording and loses the explicit completion and equivalence carried by the surface text.

findings.highlight: SetNine Lives Blade Works.
findings.evidenceJa: 全工程投影完了
findings.governingReading: The ruby cue “Set” precedes the technique name.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “Set” and “Nine.”

findings.highlight: Berserker’s still alive.
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーは健在だった
findings.governingReading: Even after being pierced throughout, Berserker remains intact enough to fight.
findings.explanation: The English reduces continued combat capability to mere survival.

findings.highlight: missing an eighth of his body
findings.evidenceJa: 体の八割を失い
findings.governingReading: Berserker has lost eighty percent of his body.
findings.explanation: The English reverses the fraction, leaving him missing only one eighth.

findings.highlight: Berserker, who’s missing an eighth of his body
findings.evidenceJa: 殺されたバーサーカー
findings.governingReading: Shirou understands Berserker as already killed by the technique yet still moving long enough to counter.
findings.explanation: The English omits the paradoxical killed-yet-active status.

findings.highlight: I raise the giant sword up to his chest
findings.evidenceJa: 大剣を胸元まで持ち上げ
findings.governingReading: Shirou raises the great sword to his own chest level before thrusting it like a spear.
findings.explanation: The English assigns “his chest” ambiguously, naturally suggesting Berserker’s chest.

findings.highlight: I used every ounce of the unfair advantage I have
findings.evidenceJa: 反則級の特権を臆面もなしに全開投入して
findings.governingReading: Shirou deploys the rule-breaking privilege at full output without a trace of shame.
findings.explanation: The English preserves scale but omits the brazen absence of restraint or shame.

findings.highlight: will only graze my head
findings.evidenceJa: こめかみを掠めていくだけ
findings.governingReading: The returning blow will barely graze Shirou’s temple.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the exact lethal point to his head.

findings.highlight: Even a grazing blow from that monstrous blade will be the end.
findings.evidenceJa: 大剣の先端、わずか数ミリが掠っただけで死ぬ
findings.governingReading: A graze of only a few millimeters from the great sword’s tip will kill him.
findings.explanation: The English omits the tip, the few-millimeter precision, and the explicit death.

findings.highlight: A direct hit can even destroy the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: 大地をも殺しかねない一撃
findings.governingReading: A direct hit is a blow capable of killing even the earth.
findings.explanation: The English normalizes the personifying death metaphor into physical destruction.

findings.highlight: My vision freezes the instant my head is blown away.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の頭が吹き飛ばされる瞬間に視界が凍る
findings.governingReading: His vision freezes at the anticipated instant when his head is about to be blown away.
findings.explanation: The English states that his head is actually blown off, contradicting the attack’s sudden stop.

findings.highlight: the white girl who emerged from her cover
findings.evidenceJa: 窪みから地上に出てきていた白い少女
findings.governingReading: Illya has come up to ground level from the depression.
findings.explanation: The English calls the hollow “cover,” implying concealment despite Berserker’s blindness and the source’s purely spatial description.

findings.highlight: He’s staring at the white girl
findings.evidenceJa: 理性のない眼で見つめていた
findings.governingReading: Berserker stares at Illya with eyes devoid of reason.
findings.explanation: The English omits the mindless quality of his gaze at the moment recognition arrests him.

findings.highlight: Without hesitation or mercy
findings.evidenceJa: 微塵も情を零さず
findings.governingReading: Shirou drives the blade in without spilling even a particle of feeling.
findings.explanation: The English moralizes emotional suppression as absence of mercy.

findings.highlight: telling me to protect her
findings.evidenceJa: おまえが守れと告げていた
findings.governingReading: To Shirou, Berserker’s fading eyes seem to say that he must protect Illya.
findings.explanation: The English removes the interpretive quality of a silent look and presents direct communication.

findings.highlight: She hesitated for a second, wondering what she could say. She couldn’t come up with anything
findings.evidenceJa: 離れていく背中を、どう止めるべきか一息だけ迷って、言葉など思いつかず
findings.governingReading: Illya hesitates for one breath over how to stop Shirou’s departing back; no words come to her.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the concrete goal of stopping him and the image of his receding back to finding something to say.

findings.highlight: yet still followed after him
findings.evidenceJa: 耐え切れなくなって外に出た
findings.governingReading: Unable to endure waiting any longer, Illya goes outside.
findings.explanation: The English turns the breaking point into generic persistence in following him.

findings.highlight: The giant who once protected her
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の守り手であった巨人
findings.governingReading: The giant had been her protector through his final action.
findings.explanation: “Once protected” distances the protective role into an earlier past, weakening the just-revealed continuity.

findings.highlight: The figure is all that’s left in her vision.
findings.evidenceJa: その背中だけが残された
findings.governingReading: Only Shirou’s back remains in Illya’s field of view.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the back—the scene’s recurring symbol—into a figure.

findings.highlight: He cast away all agonies
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる煩悶を落とした
findings.governingReading: He cast off every tormenting doubt or mental conflict when he unbound the cloth and projected.
findings.explanation: The English’s “agonies” suggests suffering or pain and loses the deliberative conflict.

findings.highlight: His body looks like someone else’s now.
findings.evidenceJa: 別人のような姿、別のものになってしまった少年の体
findings.governingReading: He looks like another person, and the boy’s body has actually become something else.
findings.explanation: The English compresses appearance and ontological bodily change into merely looking like someone else’s body.

findings.highlight: a foolish and sacred end
findings.evidenceJa: 愚かで尊い、ある一つの結末
findings.governingReading: Illya watches one foolish yet precious or noble conclusion that has lost its road back.
findings.explanation: The English makes 尊い religiously “sacred” and calls the conclusion an end, risking a claim of immediate death.

findings.highlight: Snakes with electricity are in my body
findings.evidenceJa: 電気製の蛇がいて
findings.governingReading: A single snake made of electricity is inside Shirou’s body.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes it and changes its substance into snakes accompanied by electricity.

findings.highlight: wriggling around like mad
findings.evidenceJa: 縦横無尽にはねまくっている
findings.governingReading: The electric snake bounds violently in every direction throughout his body.
findings.explanation: The English changes unrestricted bouncing into wriggling.

findings.highlight: resting
findings.evidenceJa: 腰を落とす
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot yet lower his center of gravity or settle into a crouched stance.
findings.explanation: The English changes a combat posture into resting.

findings.highlight: after defeating her
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女を、撃退してから
findings.governingReading: Rebinding and lowering his stance must wait until he drives Saber off.
findings.explanation: The English escalates repelling her into defeating her.

findings.highlight: Saber stops once I am within range.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女なら一息で踏み込める間合いで、セイバーは足を止めた
findings.governingReading: Saber approaches, then stops at a range she can cross in one breath.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou enter range rather than Saber choose where to halt.

findings.highlight: without being able to fight back
findings.evidenceJa: 躱す事さえできず
findings.governingReading: Shirou judges that if Saber cuts in, he cannot even evade before being bisected.
findings.explanation: The English changes failed evasion into inability to counterattack.

findings.highlight: I need an appropriate user to use his Noble Phantasm
findings.evidenceJa: その持ち主に使ってもらうしかない
findings.governingReading: A Noble Phantasm matching Saber’s must be used by its actual owner.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes an “appropriate user,” adds male gender, and weakens the ownership condition.

findings.highlight: has a great source of magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力を充分に供給されるようになった
findings.governingReading: Saber is now supplied with sufficient magical energy after release from Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English changes adequacy of supply into greatness of the source.

findings.highlight: She mercilessly comes to take my life.
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女は俺を斬り伏せにくる
findings.governingReading: Shirou takes Saber’s emotionless voice as the signal that she will immediately come cut him down.
findings.explanation: The English presents her as actually approaching to kill him, though she instead speaks and leaves.

findings.governingReading: Shirou begins a tiny interrupted utterance before renewing his resolve.
findings.explanation: The English leaves the displayed dialogue empty.

findings.highlight: someone who will soon die in any case
findings.evidenceJa: 自滅する者
findings.governingReading: Saber calls Shirou someone destroying himself.
findings.explanation: The English removes his agency and the self-destructive cause, leaving only impending death.

findings.highlight: leaving me nothing to spare
findings.evidenceJa: 敵を呼び止める余裕なんて一欠けらもない
findings.governingReading: Shirou has not the slightest reserve with which to call an enemy back.
findings.explanation: The English omits the concrete action he cannot afford and leaves a vague lack of resources.

findings.highlight: if I don’t want any physical defects
findings.evidenceJa: 五体満足でいたいのなら
findings.governingReading: If Shirou wants to remain whole and intact in all limbs, even one more Projection is dangerous.
findings.explanation: The English turns bodily integrity into the clinical and unnatural phrase “physical defects.”

findings.highlight: even after I die
findings.evidenceJa: 俺が戦闘不能になっても
findings.governingReading: Hope will remain even if Shirou becomes unable to fight.
findings.explanation: The English escalates combat incapacitation into death.

findings.highlight: if Saberno, if Sakura changes her mind
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーのいや、桜の気が変わったら
findings.governingReading: Shirou corrects himself from Saber to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “Saber” and “no.”

findings.highlight: My heart’s thumping loudly, jumping around inside my skull.
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓の鼓動はやけに巨大で、ギシギシと頭蓋の中を跳ね回っていた
findings.governingReading: His heartbeat is disturbingly enormous and creaks as it bounds around inside his skull.
findings.explanation: The English reduces abnormal magnitude to loudness and omits the creaking sound.
